technical.summary: CDW shows strong bullish structure with price above all key moving averages and positive momentum indicators, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI-9: 83.77, Stoch: 89.95) and band squeeze present significant pullback risk; suitable for contrarian shorts or cautious longs with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: CDW shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 82 days present material risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed market sentiment (37.5% bullish, 37.5% neutral) with moderate greed reading (56) provides neutral backdrop; insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (194.7) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 82 days adds moderate event risk but secondary to acute macro deterioration.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with RSI-9 at 83.77 and Stoch at 89.95 shows extreme momentum that could continue if breakout holds through resistance at 195.53.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI-9: 83.77, Stoch: 89.95, Williams %R overbought) combined with inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (194.7), zero fundamental catalysts, and no insider conviction create high probability of pullback to support at 193.67 or deeper.
